premise: Lola wants a tall tower and Nico a big wall; building alone, her tower slumps and his wall has nothing to guard, so they build a castle together.
inspiration: Aesop's bundle of sticks (together is stronger) made into a sand castle: each half is silly alone, and the two ideas make one castle.
lesson: Two ideas can make one better thing.

en-US.title: Two Towers
en-US.text: {girl:enter} {girl:go to sand} Lola and {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to girl} Nico were building something big. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [excited] "Let's make a tower, as tall as the lighthouse!" {surfer:live shake-head} {surfer:says} [playfully] "No, a wall! A great big wall!" {girl:face sad} {surfer:face sad} Tower. Wall. Tower. WALL. [short pause] So they each built alone. {bucket:enter} {girl:go to bucket} {girl:live play-sand} Lola filled the bucket and piled up a tower… tall, taller… {sfx:crumble} plop. It slumped over. {girl:shake} Nico patted out a long wall… but it had nothing to guard. Hmm. They looked at each other. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} "What if… a tower, with a wall around it?" {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [excited] "And a door! And a flag!" So they built it together. {girl:live play-sand} Pat, pat, scoop. {castle:enter} {surfer:go to castle} And there it stood, their sand castle, {castle:sparkle} three towers tall. {castle:live flag} Its little red flag waved. {girl:live kite} Lola flew her kite high above it, {surfer:hop x2} and Nico cheered. [happily] One castle, three towers, and two builders.

es-ES.title: Dos torres
es-ES.text: {girl:enter} {girl:go to sand} Lola y {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to girl} Nico estaban construyendo algo grande. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [excited] «¡Hagamos una torre altísima, como el faro!» {surfer:live shake-head} {surfer:says} [playfully] «¡No, una muralla! ¡Una muralla enorme!» {girl:face sad} {surfer:face sad} Torre. Muralla. Torre. MURALLA. [short pause] Así que cada uno construyó solo. {bucket:enter} {girl:go to bucket} {girl:live play-sand} Lola llenó el cubo y levantó una torre… alta, más alta… {sfx:crumble} plof. Se desplomó. {girl:shake} Nico alisó una muralla larga… pero no tenía nada que proteger. Mmm. Se miraron. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} «¿Y si… hacemos una torre, con una muralla alrededor?» {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [excited] «¡Y una puerta! ¡Y una bandera!» Así que lo hicieron juntos. {girl:live play-sand} Plas, plas, zas. {castle:enter} {surfer:go to castle} Y allí estaba su castillo de arena, {castle:sparkle} con tres torres. {castle:live flag} Su banderita roja ondeaba. {girl:live kite} Lola hizo volar su cometa por encima, {surfer:hop x2} y Nico aplaudió. [happily] Un castillo, tres torres y dos constructores.
